name: 4-Cheese Spinach Artichoke Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 8 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and excess moisture pressed out
unmapped: shredded mozzarella (board carries only daiya-mozzarella-style-shreds, no dairy mozzarella)
why: Classic keto casserole bound entirely with cream cheese, heavy cream and three cheeses over cubed chicken breast, spinach and artichoke - exactly the cheese-and-egg-bound (no pasta) baked dish the lane wants. Published 451 cal / 6g carbs / 30g protein per serving, dead-center of the band and structurally low-carb (no rice/pasta/potato). Rebuild cooked chicken on diced chicken breast; every ingredient maps to the board except dairy mozzarella.
